glance.label: A quick glance
glance.title: I turn models into things people can
glance.bio:
I'm an Informatics student at Universitas Andalas in Padang. My studies focus on artificial intelligence and data science, and web development is how I put that work in front of people.

I build front ends with React, Laravel and Tailwind CSS at PT Neo Telemetri, coordinate research and development at the campus Programming Laboratory, and reached the national finals of LIDM 2026.

A model is only useful once someone can use it. That last step, from notebook to browser, is the part I like to own.
